name: ChannelLineOvershootReversal
longCondition: haveLoLine && pokedDn && el_gt(close[0], loNow) && el_gt(close[0], open[0]) && el_ge(close[0] - open[0], bodyFraction * (high[0] - low[0]))
shortCondition: haveHiLine && pokedUp && el_lt(close[0], hiNow) && el_lt(close[0], open[0]) && el_ge(open[0] - close[0], bodyFraction * (high[0] - low[0]))
